name: Български официални празници — многоезичен (OpenHolidays editorial)
title: Български официални празници — многоезичен (OpenHolidays editorial)
description: Bulgarian statutory public holidays sourced from the openpotato/openholidaysapi.data editorial seed used by the OpenHolidays API. Each record carries the canonical OpenHolidays UUID, the start/end date pair, holiday Type (Public), RegionalScope (National for all 175 BG records — Bulgaria has no per-oblast public holiday split), and three-language names in Bulgarian (bg, native Cyrillic), German (de) and English (en). Years span 2020–2030 (11 years of editorial coverage). Complements the existing bg-praznitsi (vacanza algorithmic, bg/en/uk) and bg-oficialni-i-uchilishchni-praznitsi (vacanza algorithmic, 1991–2030) datasets — same Bulgarian holidays expressed via the alternative editorial-seed lineage with German translations included. Native Bulgarian Cyrillic preserved verbatim via ensure_ascii=False.
